title: QS World University Rankings 2027: Top 10
desc: The first ten institutions in QS World University Rankings 2027, ordered by QS overall position. Equal positions are ties; QS’s ranking reflects its own published methodology and is not a measure of every subject or every student’s fit.

source.name: QS World University Rankings 2027 (official QS table)
source.note: The first ten institutions, locations, edition, published score order and tie positions were checked against QS’s official 2027 table by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-10-23. QS ranks Imperial College London and Stanford jointly at 2, and ETH Zurich and UCL jointly at 8; the list uses the published rank positions rather than inventing scores. This is QS’s overall methodology, not a subject-specific or universal measure of university quality.
